doc: The same call with every input promoted to float64, the arithmetic a float64 port performs: no float32 rounding is left in the expression, so the closed form is checked to rtol 1e-9. Arguments: s, fine, t, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted t, streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads (the others keep their defaults). params.result_dtype ("f64" or "f32") is the dtype numpy gives the result by promotion (a float64 t array or float64 inputs give f64, a python-float t with float32 fields keeps f32); it is informational, the stored output has that dtype. Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 7.2e-16 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 2e4x that spread.
